name: claude-kit
description: Wyatt's personal Claude Code kit — a mentor that coaches and grades how he asks, and a critic that judges and grades what came back.

plugins.name: kit
plugins.description: Two operators, both measured. /mentor coaches the framing of a request before the work runs and grades the ask (framing, leverage, learnings). /critic judges in fresh context whether the thing he ASKED for actually happened and grades the delivery (delivery, evidence, scope). /scorecard publishes the board that shows both, with XP, levels, streaks and badges. Repo specifics live in .claude/KIT.md; anything missing is named out loud, never silently skipped.
